evidence.rationale: Named individual summit corresponding to Peaklist record 549 (Cerro Mellizo Sur), with published topographic prominence of 1945 m. Significance is geographic, independent of translations.

sources.title: Peaklist — World Ultras, authors and regional inventories

coordinateVerification.method: Desk review of individual summit name/recorded alias, Wikidata identity and unique Earth coordinate against the named Peaklist summit point; original GMBA membership checked separately. Positions differ by at most 300 m. No point was moved. Historical map coordinates are not survey-precision measurements.

difficultyReview.rationale: Specialist evidence establishes geographic significance. Broader recognition has not yet been established for tier promotion; provisionally Hard pending recognition review or player calibration, regardless of translation count.

difficultyReview.rationale: Specialist evidence establishes geographic significance. Broader recognition has not yet been established for tier promotion; provisionally Hard pending recognition review or player calibration, regardless of translation count.

evidence.rationale: Named individual summit corresponding to Peaklist record 764 (Cerro Cantillana), with published topographic prominence of 1784 m. Significance is geographic, independent of translations.

sources.title: Peaklist — World Ultras, authors and regional inventories

coordinateVerification.method: Desk review of individual summit name/recorded alias, Wikidata identity and unique Earth coordinate against the named Peaklist summit point; original GMBA membership checked separately. Positions differ by at most 300 m. No point was moved. Historical map coordinates are not survey-precision measurements.

difficultyReview.rationale: Specialist evidence establishes geographic significance. Broader recognition has not yet been established for tier promotion; provisionally Hard pending recognition review or player calibration, regardless of translation count.
